verdict.rationale: ChatGPT (with Codex) is itself an AI agent, so it takes the MCP client role. Serving its own tools to other agents through an official MCP server is a different product role. The MCP evidence covers only the client side: configuring third-party MCP servers such as Context7, scoping them in config.toml, and using website-offered WebMCP actions. None of it shows ChatGPT running as an MCP server, so the server axis does not apply.
